senses.gloss: eṣaka, adj. (= Pali esaka, Dhp. comm. 〔iii.417.10〕; not in PTSD; to eṣati), seeking, striving: Bbh 〔204.4〕 eṣakaṃ vīryaṃ bodhisattvasya, sarvavidyāsthānaparyeṣaṇatayā.

eṣati, ˚te (= Pali esati; very rare in Skt., BhāgP. in pw, which associates this with iṣyati; in mg. it belongs with icchati; cf. adhy˚, anv˚, pary-eṣati), seeks: SP 〔54.10〕 (vs) na buddham eṣanti; LV 〔242.10〕 (vs) na ca so tṛpti labheta bhūyu eṣan; 〔354.2〕 (vs) bodhi vara eṣatā (inst. pr. pple.); 〔364.9〕 (vs) eṣati; 〔379.11〕 (vs) agādhe gādham eṣatha (so read with v.l.); RP 〔5.14〕 (vs) eṣamāṇa varabodhim uttamām; 〔15.14〕 (vs) na ca punar eṣati kasyacit sa doṣam.
